# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" as the application name.
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 23 02:12" is shown in the center of the title bar.
- **System Notification Icon**: A bell icon is visible next to the date and time.
- **Window Control Buttons**: Three buttons are present on the right side of the title bar:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize/Restore button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: "Activities" is visible on the far left of the title bar, indicating the GNOME desktop environment.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: A horizontal menu bar with the following items from left to right:
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Icons and Panels**:
  - **Explorer Icon**: A folder icon, currently active, with a dropdown arrow.
  - **Search Icon**: A magnifying glass icon.
  - **Source Control Icon**: A branching icon.
  - **Debug Icon**: A bug icon.
  - **Extensions Icon**: A square with a plus sign.
  - **Terminal Icon**: A terminal window icon.
  - **Settings Icon**: A gear icon.
  - **Outline Icon**: A document with a folded corner.
  - **Timeline Icon**: A clock icon.
  - **User Icon**: A person silhouette icon.
  - **Grid Icon**: A 3x3 grid icon for application launcher.
- **Activity Bar Status**: The gear icon has a blue notification badge with the number "1".

## Explorer Panel

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER" is displayed at the top.
- **Folder Structure**:
  - **USER Folder**: Expanded, showing the following subdirectories and files:
    - .cache
    - .config
    - .gnupg
    - .ipython
    - .local
    - .mozilla
    - .pki
    - .ssh
    - .thunderbird
    - .var
    - .vscode
    - Desktop
    - Documents
    - Downloads
    - Music
    - Pictures
    - project
    - Public
    - server
    - snap
    - Templates
    - Videos
  - **Hidden Files and System Files**:
    - .bash_history
    - .bash_logout
    - .bashrc
    - .lesshst
    - .profile
    - .selected_editor
    - .sudo_as_admin_successful
    - .viminfo
    - requirement.txt
- **Folder Icons**: Each folder has a folder icon with a right-pointing arrow indicating it can be expanded or collapsed.
- **File Icons**: Files are shown with their respective icons (e.g., .txt file icon).

## Main Content Area

- **Welcome Page Title**: "Welcome - user - Visual Studio Code" is displayed at the top of the main content area.
- **Main Welcome Message**:
  - **Heading**: "Visual Studio Code"
  - **Subheading**: "Editing evolved"
- **Start Section**:
  - **Options**:
    - New File...
    - Open File...
    - Open Folder
    - Connect to...
- **Recent Section**:
  - **Label**: "Recent"
  - **Item**: "project" with a dropdown arrow.
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - **Title**: "Walkthroughs"
  - **Content**:
    - "Started with VS Code" with a progress bar indicating completion.
    - "Organize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding"
    - "The Fundamentals" with a progress bar indicating completion.

## Trust Dialog Box

- **Dialog Title**: "Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?"
- **Icon**: A blue shield icon with a keyhole.
- **Message**:
  - "Code provides features that may automatically execute files in this folder."
  - "If you don't trust the authors of these files, we recommend to continue in restricted mode as the files may be malicious. See our docs to learn more."
- **Path**: "/home/user"
- **Checkbox**:
  - "Trust the authors of all files in the parent folder 'home'"
- **Buttons**:
  - "No, I don't trust the authors" (gray button, labeled "Browse folder in restricted mode")
  - "Yes, I trust the authors" (blue button, labeled "Trust folder and enable all features")

## Status Bar

- **Status Bar Items**:
  - **Git Status**: "0" for unstaged changes, "0" for staged
